name: Photos
short_desc: Alpha. Back up your phone's photos and videos to your own photo server, privately.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Alpha. Photo backup for Wizard OS for Android: originals go straight from the phone to your own Immich photo server, signed in with your fingerprint (Wizard Sign-in). Wi-Fi only and first-backup-while-charging by default; nothing is deleted from the phone. Needs Wizard OS for Android 0.9.32+.
